articles.title_en: Russian strikes trigger emergency power outages in several Ukrainian regions, cutting water supply across Kyiv
articles.lead_en: One of Russia’s largest attacks on Ukraine’s energy system has been underway since the early hours of November 3, national power company Ukrenergo reported.

articles.lead_en: Russia refused to extend the ceasefire in Oleshky. Russian forces occupied Oleshky, in Ukraine’s Kherson region, in 2022, and a humanitarian catastrophe has unfolded there in recent months.
